# Advancing sequence analysis and related methods across disciplines

## New to sequence analysis?

Sequence analysis studies ordered series of states or events — such as employment careers, family trajectories or daily time use — as whole units. It describes, compares and classifies these trajectories, and links them to their antecedents and consequences.
